title: HCERT test vectors
summary: Shared test material every implementation is checked against: the smart-trust PR 129 DVC example and its DSC, the IHE ITI VHL Case B manifest, a JWE fixture made independently of the library, and the TEST-ONLY testkit keys. Each upstream set carries a SOURCE.yaml naming its repository and commit.
validatorNotApplicable: the files are verbatim upstream test material (JSON, PEM) with no $schema of their own and must not gain one; they are checked by use: check-models validates the PR 129 payload against the CDDL and SHACL, and hcert-core's tests verify the certificates and decrypt the JWE.

avatar.reads: a sheet of expected values, pinned: material a test reads, never writes
